techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
techniques.description: Adversaries communicate using HTTP/HTTPS to blend C2 traffic in with normal web traffic, often as periodic beacons.

techniques.name: Acquire Infrastructure: Domains
techniques.description: Adversaries register domains, often lookalikes of legitimate brands or infrastructure, shortly before use in a campaign.

techniques.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
techniques.description: Adversaries send links to credential-harvesting pages, often impersonating a trusted brand or internal portal.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.tactic: Defense Evasion, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Initial Access
techniques.description: Adversaries use compromised legitimate credentials to blend in with normal authentication activity.

techniques.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
techniques.description: Adversaries create scheduled tasks to establish persistence or execute code at a set time.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries exfiltrate data over the same channel used for command and control rather than a separate channel.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.description: Adversaries attempt many credential combinations to gain access to accounts.
